meta.title: Taking the Train from Da Nang to Hue – A Day in Vietnam
meta.description:
I took the train from Da Nang to Hue for a day trip, and the train journey turned out to be one of the highlights of the day.

The trip started aboard a surprisingly beautiful train, complete with comfortable seats, incredible scenery, food, drinks and even live music. Once in Hue, I spent a couple of hours exploring the Imperial City before heading out to see a little more of the city.

As usual, the day didn't quite go according to plan. I wandered through Dong Ba Market, wasn't feeling particularly well, found a very helpful local pharmacy, walked along the river as a storm rolled in, and finished the day trying some local food near the railway station before catching the train back to Da Nang.

Not exactly the day I planned — but sometimes they're the best ones.

Thanks for watching!

🇻🇳 Travelling through Vietnam and filming it as I go — no elaborate itinerary, just figuring things out along the way.
